summary_1line: Sita passionately insists that as Rama’s wife she must share his exile and accompany him to the forest despite his attempt to leave her in Ayodhya.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita stands before Rama in the palace chamber, pleading firmly to accompany him into exile despite the dangers of the forest.
Sita declares she will walk ahead of Rama through the forest, clearing thorns and kusa grass from his path with her hands.
Sita imagines living happily with Rama in the wild forest among beasts, surviving on fruits and roots while serving him devotedly.
